blocks.title: Cis-trans isomers
blocks.text: Open chain compounds mein double bond ke gird rotation (ghoomna) ruka hua hota hai. Is wajah se jin stereoisomers ke atoms ki space mein tarteeb mukhtalif ho jaye, unhein cis-trans isomers kehte hain.
Sab se pehle butane mein C-C single bond ke gird aazad rotation ko dekhte hain.

blocks.alt: Butane ki do tasweerein, I aur II, gardish ke nishan wale teer se jureen. I mein carbon 2 par oopar baen CH3 (carbon 1) aur do H; carbon 3 par do H aur neeche daen CH3 (carbon 4). II mein C2-C3 bond par gardish se carbon 1 neeche baen (H3C) aa gaya, oopar baen aur baen H; carbon 3 wahi hai.
blocks.caption: Butane ki do shakalein (I aur II) jo C2-C3 single bond par gardish se aik doosre mein badalti hain (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: C-2 aur C-3 ke darmiyan single bond aik σ bond hai jo orbitals ke seedhe aamne saamne milap se banta hai, is liye ghoomne se yeh bond nahi toot'ta. Shakal I ko ghumayein to II ban jati hai aur wapas bhi; is liye I aur II conformational isomers hain jinhein room temperature par alag nahi kiya ja sakta.

Butane ki shakal I aur II conformational isomers kehlati hain, kyun ke C-C single bond ke aazad rotation se yeh aik doosre mein badal jati hain. Inhein room temperature (kamre ke darja hararat) par alag nahi kiya ja sakta.
Jab C-2 aur C-3 ke darmiyan wala single bond ghoomta hai to methyl groups bhi ghoom jate hain, aur is aazad rotation se shakal I, II mein aur II wapas I mein badal jati hai.

Ab but-2-ene, CH₃–CH=CH–CH₃, ko dekhein. Is ke carbon 2 aur 3 dono sp² hybridized hain. C=C double bond mein aik σ (sigma) bond hai jo sp² hybrid orbitals ke seedhe aamne saamne milap (linear overlap) se banta hai, aur aik π (pi) bond hai jo p orbitals ke pehlu ba pehlu milap (parallel overlap) se banta hai. π bond molecule ko aik hi position mein jakar deta hai. Double bond ke dono carbon (C-2 aur C-3) aur un se jure tamam groups aik hi plane mein hote hain aur space mein un ki jagah fixed hoti hai. Double bond ke gird ghoomne ke liye pehle π bond ko torna parega, jis ke liye 263 kJ/mol energy chahiye; yeh room temperature par mumkin nahi. Is liye C=C ke gird rotation ruka hua (restricted) hai, aur yahi rukawat cis-trans isomerism ki wajah hai (Figure 19.6).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke π bond “ρ orbitals” (Yunani harf rho) ke milap se banta hai. Sahi “p orbitals” hai.

blocks.alt: But-2-ene ki teen tasweerein, p orbitals neeli lobes ki shakal mein. Cis: do C jure, har aik ki lobes oopar aur neeche jo aapas mein mil kar pi bond banati hain (electron jora); oopar hashed bonds par H, neeche wedges par H3C aur CH3. Beech: aik carbon 90 darje ghooma hua, us ka p orbital doosre ke amudi (perpendicular), har lobe mein aik electron: koi milap nahi. Trans: cis jaisa magar oopar daen CH3 aur neeche daen H. Tasweeron ke darmiyan kaate hue dohre teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.6: But-2-ene ke do isomers pi bond tore baghair C-C double bond par gardish se aik doosre mein nahi badal sakte (kitab ki Figure 19.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: π bond p orbitals ke pehlu ba pehlu milap (sideways overlap) se banta hai, aur yeh milap tabhi hota hai jab dono p orbitals aik doosre ke parallel (aik seedh mein) hon. Aik sira 90 darje ghumayein to orbitals perpendicular (aik doosre par khare) ho jate hain aur milap khatam: yani π bond toot jata hai. Is ke liye 263 kJ/mol chahiye jo room temperature par nahi milti, is liye cis aur trans aik doosre mein nahi badalte (kate hue teer).
Ab upar wale structures ko cis-trans isomers samjha ja sakta hai aur in ke naam yun hain:

blocks.alt: Do structural formulas: cis-but-2-ene, C=C jis ke oopar H3C aur CH3 dono aur neeche H aur H; trans-but-2-ene, C=C jis ke oopar H aur CH3 aur neeche H3C aur H.
blocks.caption: Cis-but-2-ene aur trans-but-2-ene (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Cis isomer woh hai jis mein do aik jaise groups double bond ki aik hi taraf hon. Trans isomer woh hai jis mein do aik jaise groups double bond ki ulti taraf hon. Yaad rahe: agar double bond ke kisi aik carbon par do aik jaise groups lage hon to cis-trans isomerism mumkin nahi. Maslan:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: But-1-ene mein carbon 1 par do H hain, aur 2,3-dimethylbut-2-ene mein har double bond wale carbon par do CH₃ hain. Aise carbon ke do groups ko aapas mein badal dein to wahi molecule banta hai, is liye cis aur trans ki do alag shakalein nahi banti.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Cis aur trans isomers ki physical aur chemical properties mukhtalif hoti hain. Trans isomers apne cis isomers se zyada stable hote hain, is liye un ki chemical reactivity bhi mukhtalif hoti hai. Isi tarah dono ki physical properties, jaise melting point, boiling point, dipole moment, density aur heat of vapourisation, bhi mukhtalif hoti hain.
Upar ke dono compounds cis-trans isomerism nahi dikhate.

blocks.title: Cis-trans isomerism ki shart
blocks.text: Open chain compound cis-trans isomerism tabhi dikhata hai jab (1) us ke molecule mein double bond ho, aur (2) double bond wale har carbon atom se do mukhtalif groups jure (attached) hon.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke groups har carbon se “attacked” hon; sahi lafz “attached” (jure hue) hai.

blocks.prompt: Pent-2-ene cis-trans isomerism dikhata hai lekin pent-1-ene nahi. Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Pent-1-ene (CH₂=CH–CH₂CH₂CH₃) ke carbon 1 par do H atoms hain, is liye sirf aik tarteeb mumkin hai. Pent-2-ene (CH₃–CH=CH–CH₂CH₃) mein double bond ke har carbon par do mukhtalif groups (H aur alkyl group) hain.

items: Single bond aazadi se ghoomta hai (conformations); C=C ka π bond rotation rokta hai (todne ko 263 kJ/mol).
Cis: aik jaise groups aik taraf; trans: ulti taraf.
Shart: double bond ho aur us ke har carbon par do mukhtalif groups hon.
